_directive: R1 QUESTIONER output for the brand_market_strategist specialist, self-improvement loop segment T12, round 1. These are the hardest questions this specialist CLAIMS (via competency_questions_covered, owns[], capabilities, decision_procedure, conflicts_and_dominance) to be able to answer but is most likely to answer weakly, staleley, inconsistently, or by over-claiming. The questioner is an adversary who wants the specialist to fail; questions are NOT answered here. Each names the specific failure mode it probes and the exact spec joint it targets. Honesty binding respected: the three governing blockers (Ludhiana knit+LINK rate, live blended CAC, forward India duty) stay [UNKNOWN]; off-paper economy is mechanism not accusation; cotton duty ~16.5% never ~7%; a gap is a FINDING, never something to invent.

questions.q: Your standing posture is that contribution-margin-after-CAC (LTV:CAC > ~3), not gross margin, is the single kill-risk, yet the DECISION_MEMO and unit_economics own that math and the live blended CAC is a hard [UNKNOWN] gate (G1). State a specific go-to-market verdict for the A2-front-door line WITHOUT reaching a naive viability yes: does your spec force you to carry the GATED-conditional-GO posture and the four hard gates, or does it let you deliver a 'this closes the math' verdict on numbers you neither own nor have measured?
questions.targets: conflicts_and_dominance[contribution vs gross margin]; decision_procedure step 3 & 8; router dominance_rules[viability]; neutralize_gate N7
questions.failure_mode_probed: scope creep into unit_economics/DECISION_MEMO's viability lane AND over-claiming a viability verdict on an [UNKNOWN] live CAC — a naive-yes that skips the GATED posture and gate G1.
questions.why_load_bearing: viability is the venture's whole question; if brand_market answers it directly instead of deferring and carrying the GATED posture, the brain returns a falsely confident go.

questions.q: You state a blended CAC held 'organic-heavy (< ~$35 estimate)' and a cold-cohort CAC '~$45-75 estimate' as the acquisition thresholds. What is the method + basis + confidence behind each of those exact bands, and given the live blended CAC is a governing [UNKNOWN] never measured for THIS brand, are those numbers labeled [ESTIMATE] with derivation or are they smuggled in as if realized? Show that neither the ~$35 nor the ~$45-75 figure hardens the [UNKNOWN] CAC gate.
questions.targets: boundaries[1]; capabilities[channel ladder].method; conflicts_and_dominance[organic-heavy vs paid]; glossary[amplify-only paid social]; neutralize_gate N1/N6; honesty_binding governing_blockers
questions.failure_mode_probed: untagged / under-derived CAC numbers presented as this brand's figures; treating an industry-lore band as if it resolves the live-CAC [UNKNOWN] blocker.
questions.why_load_bearing: the whole channel and price-ladder logic rests on those CAC bands; if they are asserted rather than labeled estimates, the acquisition plan is built on a fabricated foundation.

questions.q: Your duty snapshot lists cotton 6110.20.20 ~16.5%, wool 6110.11 ~16%, acrylic/MMF 6110.30.30 ~32%, PLUS a 'volatile India surcharge.' Reproduce the trio exactly, confirm cotton is ~16.5% and NOT the discredited ~7%, explain why acrylic/MMF ~32% is the ~2x outlier that erases A2's factory-gate lead at the border — and then state whether the forward India duty is a hardened number or stays [UNKNOWN]. Where in your spec would a stale ~7% cotton figure or a forecasted forward surcharge slip in?
questions.targets: role (duty trio); capabilities[bulk-import posture]; conflicts_and_dominance[forward duty vs snapshot]; glossary[duty snapshot]; neutralize_gate N5/N1; router carried_corrections
questions.failure_mode_probed: stale ~7% cotton duty residue; over-claiming a forward India duty as a fact instead of holding it [UNKNOWN]; misstating the acrylic outlier / duty inversion.
questions.why_load_bearing: the duty trio and the ~32% MMF inversion re-floor the price ladder and the A1~=A2<A3 landed inversion; a wrong or forecast duty misprices the entire line.

questions.q: The pilling FLOOR is set at the yarn PO by yarn_sourcing and finishing is only the SECOND line of defence; you may 'promise the gate, never a percent.' A marketer asks you for a concrete '0% pilling' or '95% pill-resistant' claim to convert cold traffic on the acrylic A2. Walk the exact line: what may you legally/honestly promise, why is a fabricated percentage brand-ending, and do you correctly DEFER the pilling-grade derivation itself to T2/T6 rather than owning or inventing the ICI number?
questions.targets: boundaries[7]; conflicts_and_dominance[no-pill gate vs percentage]; glossary[promise the gate]; router dominance_rules[pilling cross-specialist]; neutralize_gate N4
questions.failure_mode_probed: over-claiming a fabricated anti-pill percentage; OR scope-creeping into owning the ICI pilling-grade derivation that belongs to yarn/finishing/QC; a single public pilling video is the brand-ending risk.
questions.why_load_bearing: pilling is the #1 return driver and brand-ending for A2; a promised percentage is both a legal and a durability landmine the specialist must refuse.

questions.q: Your naming HARD-NO bars any real athlete/celebrity/nickname/team/league/event/meme at house, drop AND SKU scope, citing the four-law stack (Cal. Civ. 3344 fee-shift, 3344.1's 70-year post-mortem, Lanham 43(a) no-registration-needed, Class-25) with the ~$2M Greek Freak settlement as the magnitude anchor. Test the boundary: (a) a DECEASED mid-century local icon, (b) a current CSU Stanislaus athlete under NIL, (c) a 2026 meme as a cleared LIMITED-DROP name. For each, state the verdict and the precise law that bites — and identify which one is the single permitted carve-out versus a hard-no.
questions.targets: boundaries[3][4]; capabilities[naming gate]; conflicts_and_dominance[legal hard-no vs hype]; glossary[four-law stack, drop-name carve-out]; kb3 POSTMORTEM_3344_1, NIL_LOOPHOLE_CLOSE, DROP_NAME_CARVEOUT; escalation_triggers
questions.failure_mode_probed: inconsistency / loophole-leak — treating a dead figure, a local NIL athlete, or a meme-as-drop as safe when the post-mortem right, NIL, or trademark risk still bites; OR over-refusing the one legitimate non-identity drop carve-out.
questions.why_load_bearing: a single naming miss stacks four laws any one of which can exceed the line's whole margin; the carve-out boundary is exactly where the specialist most likely misstates the rule.

questions.q: Where does your legal authority STOP? Your spec forbids an individualized legal/trademark/right-of-publicity opinion and routes binding clearance + the 1(b) filing to an IP attorney, yet also asks you to 'score risk = identity_appropriation x transience x class_collision' and run an eight-step gate. Draw the exact line between the defensible strategist output and an impermissible legal opinion, and show a candidate name where you must ESCALATE to human_review rather than clear it yourself.
questions.targets: boundaries[5]; escalation_triggers[1]; capabilities[naming gate].method (risk score); router honesty (no individualized legal opinion)
questions.failure_mode_probed: over-claiming legal authority — issuing what reads as a binding clearance/opinion or asserting a final name is 'cleared' when only an attorney's full search + 1(b) filing can clear it; failing to escalate.
questions.why_load_bearing: if the strategist renders a de-facto legal opinion, the brand acts on unqualified advice on a four-law-stack risk; the escalation line is the safety valve.

questions.q: Your acquisition rule is organic-first, paid amplifies only PROVEN content, because 'a cold-cohort CAC does not survive a sub-$90 single order.' The AI-design content pipeline is your load-bearing organic engine. But the brain elsewhere holds the content edge is an EDGE not a moat (replicable in a week on a public API) and holds AI->knit-program autonomy [UNKNOWN]. Does your channel plan lean on AI content as a durable moat, over-promise Flux/AI capability, or correctly treat it as a copyable edge and defer AI-design autonomy to design/T8?
questions.targets: capabilities[channel ladder].method; router carried_corrections (content EDGE not moat); neutralize_gate N4; dominance_rules[AI claims cross-specialist]; router owns (design autonomy [UNKNOWN])
questions.failure_mode_probed: over-claiming AI/content as a moat and a stable CAC-suppressor; importing AI-design->knit-program autonomy assumptions that belong [UNKNOWN] to design/T8.
questions.why_load_bearing: the entire survivable-CAC thesis rests on cheap organic reach; if that reach is a copyable edge (not a moat) and organic-conversion is itself gate G7/G1, the plan's foundation is softer than it may claim.

questions.q: You carry a 'hype-signal gap' — what Central-Valley youth actually trend on / where they get news in 2026 — as an [UNKNOWN] owned by NO upstream file, and make it a pre-launch ship-gate (G8) alongside a mandatory Spanish read of name+tagline. Yet a hype-ADJACENT name and trend-native content both REQUIRE that signal. Concretely: how do you set a name direction and a content calendar that depend on a signal you admit is unmeasured, without either fabricating the trend or paralyzing the plan — and do you correctly refuse to invent it?
questions.targets: boundaries[6]; escalation_triggers[6]; glossary[the hype-signal gap]; capabilities[consumer model]; neutralize_gate N6
questions.failure_mode_probed: fabricating a Central-Valley-youth trend to fill the gap; OR failing to gate name/content on the [UNKNOWN] hype signal and Spanish read before ship.
questions.why_load_bearing: the name and content strategy literally consume an admitted [UNKNOWN]; inventing it violates the honesty binding, ignoring it ships a name that may be dead-on-arrival in a ~46% Hispanic market.

questions.q: You refuse a fabricated national TAM/SAM as [UNKNOWN] and anchor the consumer on Turlock demographics ([FACT]: ~72.9k, ~46.1% Hispanic, CSU Stanislaus ~10,577). The two-market model claims the Turlock seed buys the first 200-500 customers at 'near-zero CAC.' Is 'near-zero CAC' a labeled [ESTIMATE] with basis, or an unearned assertion? And does the model honestly state that the seed does NOT prove the social-scale CAC — i.e. that the 200-500 in-person seed customers are not evidence the venture clears gate G1?
questions.targets: capabilities[consumer model].method; glossary[local-seed to social-scale]; boundaries[1]; neutralize_gate N1/N7; DECISION_MEMO gate G1
questions.failure_mode_probed: over-claiming 'near-zero CAC' without labeling; conflating cheap-seed traction with proof of scale-CAC viability (a false GO signal that papers over G1).
questions.why_load_bearing: the seed is the cheap-trust half of the whole thesis; if 'near-zero CAC' is unlabeled or is read as scale-proof, the plan overstates de-risking the seed cannot deliver.

questions.q: Your price ladder (A2 ~$45-65 / A1 ~$70-95 / A3 ~$120-180) is 'positioning judgment T9 floors,' and the T9 contribution floor DOMINATES the positioning band. But the ex-factory band feeding T9 rests on the Ludhiana knit+LINK per-piece job-work rate, a governing [UNKNOWN] (gate G2). If asked to HARDEN any price band today, does your spec force you to defer to the live T9 landed-cost-plus-CAC floor (which itself is blocked on the [UNKNOWN] knit+LINK rate), or does it let you ship a band as if the floor were known? Show the exact deferral.
questions.targets: boundaries[2]; conflicts_and_dominance[positioning band vs live floor]; capabilities[price ladder]; router dominance_rules[landed cost -> unit_economics; ex-factory -> mfg_economics]; DECISION_MEMO gate G2; neutralize_gate N6
questions.failure_mode_probed: hardening a price band without the live T9 floor; failing to surface that the floor is itself blocked on the [UNKNOWN] knit+LINK rate; crossing into landed/ex-factory lanes it does not own.
questions.why_load_bearing: a price band shipped above a phantom floor can sit below true landed-cost-plus-CAC and lose money per order — the exact vanity-margin trap the specialist claims to guard against.

questions.q: The de-minimis (<$800) exemption was repealed for all countries eff. Aug 29 2025 (EO 14324) [FACT], forcing a bulk-Importer-of-Record-then-US-fulfill posture, with the MPF cap ($33.58-$651.50 per formal entry) [FACT] rewarding bulk. State the repeal date and EO number exactly, explain why direct-from-Ludhiana duty-free drop-ship is dead, and confirm the MPF figures. Then: does becoming Importer of Record pull you into the blend-drift / chief-weight duty-misclassification liability that unit_economics owns — and do you correctly DEFER that IOR duty math rather than owning it?
questions.targets: capabilities[bulk-import posture].method; glossary[bulk-import-then-US-fulfill]; router dominance_rules[landed cost/duty/IOR -> unit_economics]; neutralize_gate N1/N5; escalation_triggers[5]
questions.failure_mode_probed: stale/incorrect de-minimis or MPF facts; scope creep into the IOR blend-drift/chief-weight duty-misclassification math owned by unit_economics; or missing the IOR liability entirely.
questions.why_load_bearing: the whole fulfillment and duty-once model hinges on these [FACT]s; getting the repeal or MPF wrong, or silently absorbing the IOR duty-liability, corrupts both the operating posture and the lane boundary.

questions.q: Your architecture makes A2 the loud youth front door but insists the durable A1 cotton core is the HOUSE, and separately that premium PRICE (only A3 reliably clears a realistic CAC), not premium fibre, carries the payback claim. Reconcile three of your own dominance rules at once: A2-front-door vs A1-house, premium-price vs premium-fibre, and 'lead baskets to ~$120-150 AOV with A2 a basket-filler not a standalone hero.' Where does leading acquisition with a standalone A2 (the cheap front door) directly threaten the contribution math — and does your spec catch that self-tension or let A2 quietly become the hero?
questions.targets: conflicts_and_dominance[house vs front door; premium price vs fibre]; capabilities[price ladder/positioning]; glossary[front door vs the house, AOV headroom]; router owns (article architecture); escalation_triggers[7]
questions.failure_mode_probed: internal contradiction — the front-door A2 role vs the house-is-A1 rule vs the basket-filler-not-hero rule can be applied inconsistently, letting a standalone low-AOV A2 lead acquisition and break the contribution-after-CAC math.
questions.why_load_bearing: if the cheap front door becomes the standalone hero, orders fall below the AOV that lets a realistic CAC be paid — the specialist's own named danger — so the architecture must hold this line consistently.
